metadata.title: Pappus's hexagon theorem for geodesic curves in $\SLR$ geometry
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we continue our investigation of the structure of Thurston geometries with non-constant curvature. We generalize the notion of cylinders, prove that they contain the types of geodesic curves. Moreover, we formulate and prove a statement analogous to Pappus's hexagon theorem for $\SLR$ geometry.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 继续研究非恒曲率Thurston几何，在SL₂相关几何中推广cylinder概念，证明其包含相应类型测地线，并建立Pappus六边形定理的类比命题。
analysis.breakthrough: 把经典关联构型推进至特定非恒曲率几何模型。
analysis.limitations: 摘要未给cylinder、相交方式及Pappus类比的精确条件，需依正文解释。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 特殊三维几何构型，曲率分析关联较间接。
